description: Farzana wears an ivory floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold-brown geometric embroidered panels and borders at the neckline, bodice, cuffs, centre and hem. A richly woven sash has a round decorated buckle and hanging beaded tassels. A rust-brown wrap with narrow gold geometric borders lies around her forearms. Gold-toned hanging earrings, bracelets and closed brown decorated shoes are visible. Her swept-back dark rear gathering is uncovered.
